race.comment: MOONYA LAD (1) is unlucky to still be a maiden finishing runner-up in both outings this campaign and strikes a very winnable contest here. Kennedy sticks in the irons following the past couple of placings and maps ideally for this contest from gate three. Rates the testing material. JUST A DUCHESS (8) was a touch disappointing last time out but the two runs prior to start the preparation were full of merit. Can bounce right back. LILSISTERDON'TCHA (7) has hit the top-four in four of her past five starts and looks to be on the doorstep of a maiden victory. Top-three credentials. PROPER BENDER (9) gets in well at the weights with the claim and may earn some minor money. IT'S SHOWTIME (3) has placed two from two around this circuit and is a must for the multiples.
